title: Can LLM Annotators Match Human Consistency? Benchmarking Human Agreement and Optimizing Multi-Agent with Contrastive Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.32415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based annotation has advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world practice. Actual annotation often involves lengthy, task-specific guidelines, and different annotators may produce divergent but reasonable judgments, especially on boundary cases, where single-labeled dataset fail to reflect this disagreement. This gap also limits existing single-agent and workflow-based annotation systems, which often lack adaptability to complex, evolving guidelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce ANT-A Benchmark, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark spanning 7 datasets across domains and modalities, with task-specific guidelines and 5 independent human labels per instance. ANT-A enables a distribution-aware evaluation, using Fleiss kappa to assess how closely model annotations align with human labeling distributions. translated_title: 大语言模型标注员能否匹配人类一致性？基于对比知识的人类一致性基准测试与多智能体优化
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的标注技术发展迅速，但现有基准测试仍与真实世界实践脱节。实际标注任务通常涉及冗长的、特定于任务的标注指南，且不同标注者可能产生不同但均属合理的判断，尤其是在边界案例上，而单标签数据集无法反映这种分歧。这一差距也限制了现有的单智能体和基于工作流的标注系统，它们通常缺乏对复杂且不断演变的标注指南的适应能力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了ANT-A基准，这是一个真实世界的多标注者基准，涵盖跨领域、跨模态的7个数据集，包含特定任务的标注指南以及每个实例5个独立的人工标签。ANT-A支持分布感知的评估，使用Fleiss kappa来衡量模型标注与人类标注分布的接近程度。我们进一步提出了ANT-OR，一个多智能体标注框架，通过蒸馏对比知识来优化提示词……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了真实世界多标注者基准ANT-A（使用Fleiss kappa进行分布感知评估，衡量LLM标注与人类标注分布的一致性），并配套提出通过蒸馏对比知识优化提示词的多智能体标注框架ANT-OR，以提升标注系统对复杂标注指南的适应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ANT-A, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark enabling distribution-aware evaluation of LLM annotators against human labeling distributions via Fleiss' kappa, together with ANT-OR, a multi-agent annotation framework that refines prompts by distilling contrastive knowledge to better adapt to complex, evolving annotation guidelines.
